g.text: TOP-TO-BOTTOM HIGH-LEVEL SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
TrialReady LK — Sri Lankan Driving Academy Management & AI Trial Readiness Platform
LAYER 1 → 7
LAYER 1: PRESENTATION & CLIENT PLATFORMS
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
React 19 SPA • TypeScript 5.8 • Tailwind CSS v4 • Vite 7 • React Router v7 • Lucide React
• Administrator Dashboard — Campus branches, staff roster, fleet management, and billing ledgers
• Instructor Practical Portal — Daily in-car lessons, attendance, 7-maneuver grading, and session notes
• Student Learner Hub — 7-Stage journey, mock theory exam simulator, and fee statements
• 18 Feature Subsystems — Best Performing Leaderboard, Glassmorphic responsive mobile/desktop UI
(HTTPS / TLS 1.3 Anycast)
LAYER 2: EDGE CDN & TRANSPORT SECURITY
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
Vercel Serverless Edge CDN • TLS 1.3 / HTTP/2 / HTTP/3 • Anycast DNS • Edge DDoS Shield
• Global Edge Delivery (<50ms Latency) — Distributed cache for single-page assets and instant hydration
• Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) — Strict TLS 1.3 encryption neutralizing eavesdropping and MITM attacks
• Automated Git CI/CD Deployments — Atomic zero-downtime production rollouts via Vercel Edge
• CORS Strict Domain Isolation — Restricted cross-origin policies and auth route perimeter rate limiting
(Encrypted API Gateway)
LAYER 3: PREPROCESSING, INPUT VALIDATION & AUTHENTICATION
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
Zod v3 Schemas • GoTrue Auth Engine • Bcrypt (Salt ≥ 10) • Stateless JWT (RFC 7519) • UTF-8 BOM
• Zod Strict Type Sanitizer — Schema-driven payload validation preventing prototype pollution
• 30-Day Permit Expiry Countdown (Δt) — Real-time timer tracking statutory renewal deadlines
• Trilingual Context Token Resolver — Dynamic i18n runtime switching across English, Sinhala, Tamil
• Anti-XSS Virtual DOM Encoding — React JSX data binding eliminating DOM script execution
• 7-Maneuver Mandatory Skill Bitmask — Bitwise competency tracker across official DMT skills
• RFC-4180 CSV Formula Sanitizer — Neutralizes spreadsheet RCE injection (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`)
(Feature Vectors & Auth Claims)
LAYER 4: AI INFERENCE & CORE BUSINESS LOGIC ENGINES
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
Multivariate Scoring Engine • Rule-Based AI Classifier • Interval Scheduling • CSS3 Print Engine
• 6-Factor AI Composite Readiness Algorithm: S = Σ(W_i · s_i) ∈ [0, 100]%
[NTMI Medical 15% + DMT Permit 15% + Theory 15% + Hours 25% + Skills 20% + Stars 10%]
• Regulatory Veto Classifier — Instant hard lock for expired permits (<0d), unpassed medicals, or <10 practical hours
• Adaptive Theory Diagnostics — Highway Code category weakness profiler & dynamic personalized remedial drill generator
• Fleet Scheduling Collision Prevention — Temporal intersection geometry preventing instructor and vehicle double-booking
• Browser-Native Vector Print Engine — Pure `@media print` CSS generating official A4 DMT Logbooks (`DMT/SL/LOG-01`)
• Official Trial Admission Passes (`DMT/SL/ADM-PASS`) — Eliminates binary PDF server exploits (Zero-PDF attack vector)
• Deterministic Rule Engine — 100% mathematical auditability with zero hallucinations or black-box drift
(Prepared RESTful Payloads)
LAYER 5: BACKEND SERVICES & KERNEL ROW-LEVEL SECURITY
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
PostgREST API Engine • PostgreSQL 15 RLS • Prepared SQL Statements • RBAC Scoped Policies
• PostgREST High-Throughput REST API — Automated schema-to-REST API layer with sub-millisecond execution latency
• Kernel-Level Row-Level Security (RLS) — Database multi-tenancy enforced by driving_school_id = auth.uid()
• Zero Cross-School Tenant Leakage — Absolute mathematical isolation between rival driving academy entities
• Parameterized Prepared SQL (Anti-SQLi) — 100% parameter-bound queries completely mitigating SQL Injection
• Role-Scoped DB Policies (Admin/Ins/Stud) — Fine-grained read/write privileges enforcing least-privilege principles
• Tamper-Evident Transaction Audit Logging — Immutable database trigger logs for financial and exam compliance
(Authenticated SQL Queries & Offline Sync)
LAYER 6: HYBRID DATA STORES & PERSISTENCE
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
PostgreSQL 15 Relational DB • HTML5 Web Storage API (LocalStorage Engine) • JSONB Schemas
• Primary Cloud Database — Managed PostgreSQL 15 database structured into 18 multi-tenant relational tables
• Offline Fallback Engine — Persistent client LocalStorage (trialready_*) delivering 100% uptime without internet
• Deterministic Seed Dataset — Royal Driving Academy preset configured with 5 realistic user personas
• Schema-Matched State Sync — Transparent dual-mode switching between live Supabase cloud and local storage
(Statutory Alignment & Cloud Hosting)
LAYER 7: INTEGRATED EXTERNAL STATUTORY & REGULATORY ECOSYSTEM
🛠️ TOOLS & TECH:
Sri Lanka Motor Traffic Act No. 14 of 1951 • NTMI Directives • LankaQR / CBSL • Supabase BaaS • Vercel Edge
• Department of Motor Traffic (DMT) — Statutory testing syllabi and Werahera practical trial ground specifications
• National Transport Medical Institute (NTMI) — Official driver medical fitness clearance & barcode verification
• LankaQR / Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) — National standard QR rails for instant tuition installment collection
• Supabase Cloud & Vercel Edge — Enterprise serverless hosting, managed PostgreSQL 15, and global Anycast delivery
